payload.name: Kubera
payload.description: 跟踪净资产并发现趋势
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask questions about your Kubera portfolio.

Connect your Kubera account to access your live balance sheet data, including net worth, assets, liabilities, and allocation.

The assistant uses this data to answer questions, surface patterns, and explain what’s in your portfolio.

Example questions:

- What is my current net worth?
- What stands out in my balance sheet?
- Where am I overly concentrated?
- Summarize my assets, liabilities, and entities
- What questions should I ask my advisor?
- Update my Tesla shares to 100 units

Kubera is the Balance Sheet for those who manage their own wealth. https://www.kubera.com/
payload.longDescription:
询问有关 Kubera 投资组合的问题。

连接 Kubera 账户，访问实时资产负债表数据，包括净资产、资产、负债及配置。

助手利用这些数据回答问题、发现规律，并解释投资组合的构成。

问题示例：

- 我目前的净资产是多少？
- 我的资产负债表中有哪些值得注意的情况？
- 我在哪些方面配置过于集中？
- 总结我的资产、负债及实体
- 我应该向顾问提出哪些问题？
- 将我的 Tesla 持股更新为 100 股

Kubera 是为自行管理财富的人打造的资产负债表。https://www.kubera.com/

payload.name: VODER
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your books, in plain English. Connect Xero, FreshBooks, MYOB or QuickBooks Online (QBO) to VODER. Ask about cash, invoices, payments and financial reports in ChatGPT, without hunting through accounting screens.
payload.longDescription: 用日常英语了解你的账簿。将Xero、FreshBooks、MYOB或QuickBooks Online（QBO）连接到VODER。在ChatGPT中询问现金、发票、付款和财务报告，无需在会计界面中四处查找。

payload.name: Synci
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Synci connects your real bank, brokerage, and crypto-exchange accounts to AI assistants,
read-only. Ask about balances, transactions, holdings, and spending across all your
accounts in one place:

"What did I spend on groceries last month?"
"Which subscriptions am I paying for, and what do they cost per year?"
"How is my portfolio allocated across stocks, ETFs, and crypto?"
"Compare my checking account balance today with the start of the month."
"Are any of my bank connections failing?"

Synci aggregates accounts across thousands of institutions:
- Banks in Europe and the UK via GoCardless Bank Account Data
- Banks in New Zealand via Akahu
- Investment brokerages and crypto exchanges via SnapTrade

All connected accounts are visible through one MCP server, in their native currencies.
payload.longDescription:
Synci 以只读方式将真实银行、证券经纪和加密货币交易所账户连接到 AI 助手。
在同一处询问所有账户的余额、交易、持仓和支出：

“我上个月买食品花了多少钱？”
“我在付费订阅哪些服务，每年各花多少钱？”
“我的投资组合在股票、ETF 和加密货币之间如何配置？”
“比较今天与月初的活期账户余额。”
“我的银行连接有没有出现故障？”

Synci 汇总数千家机构的账户：
- 通过 GoCardless Bank Account Data 连接欧洲和英国的银行
- 通过 Akahu 连接新西兰的银行
- 通过 SnapTrade 连接投资证券经纪商和加密货币交易所

所有已连接账户均可通过一个 MCP 服务器查看，金额以各账户的原生货币显示。

payload.name: FinancialFilings
payload.description: 公司申报文件与财务数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FinancialFilings gives ChatGPT access to filings, call transcripts, and normalized financials for listed and delisted companies worldwide, 35 million+ filings across 85,000+ tickers, with 20+ years of history. Ask for any company's latest annual report, pull a specific financial line item with its currency and fiscal period, search a filing's full text, or compare metrics across peers. Sign in with your free FinancialFilings account using OAuth, no API key needed. Built on the open Model Context Protocol.
payload.longDescription: FinancialFilings 让 ChatGPT 访问全球上市和退市公司的申报文件、电话会议文字稿及标准化财务数据，覆盖 85,000+ 个证券代码、35 million+（3,500 万+）份申报文件，拥有 20+ 年历史。可询问任何公司的最新年报，提取特定财务科目及其币种和财务期间，搜索申报全文，或比较同行指标。使用免费的 FinancialFilings 账户通过 OAuth 登录，无需 API 密钥。基于开放的模型上下文协议构建。

payload.name: Exum: ExoScope Crypto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Browse live crypto markets and open interactive ExoScope charts inside ChatGPT.
View candlestick price action, 24h moves, ranked Binance USDT pairs, and recent market events — then jump to the full Exum desk for indicators, AI terminal, and alerts.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中浏览实时加密资产市场，并打开交互式 ExoScope 图表。
查看蜡烛图价格走势、24h 涨跌、按排名排列的 Binance USDT 交易对及近期市场事件，再跳转到完整的 Exum 工作台，使用指标、AI 终端和提醒功能。

payload.name: Fugle-Stock
payload.description: 连接富果投资平台，管理关注列表、投资笔记、到价提醒和市场信息
payload.summaryOriginal: 串接富果投資平台，管理您的追蹤清單、投資筆記、到價提醒和市場
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 將您的富果 Fugle 投資平台與 ChatGPT 無縫整合，打造個人化的智慧投資助理。透過自然語言對話，您可以管理追蹤股票、投資筆記、股價到價通知，並獲取專業市場分析與研究報告內容。本工具不提供任何投資建議，所有資訊僅供參考。
payload.longDescription: 将您的富果 Fugle 投资平台与 ChatGPT 无缝整合，打造个性化的智能投资助手。通过自然语言对话，您可以管理关注股票、投资笔记、股价到价通知，并获取专业市场分析和研究报告内容。本工具不提供任何投资建议，所有信息仅供参考。

payload.name: LONA™
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LONA Trading Assistant helps you develop, backtest, and optimize algorithmic trading strategies using AI. Upload market data from supported exchanges, write Python-based trading strategies, and run comprehensive backtests to see how your strategies would have performed historically. View detailed performance reports with interactive charts showing entry/exit points, returns, and risk metrics.
payload.longDescription: LONA交易助手通过AI帮助您开发、回测和优化算法交易策略。上传来自支持交易所的市场数据，编写基于Python的交易策略，并运行全面的回测，以查看您的策略在过去的表现情况。查看包含交互式图表的详细绩效报告，展示进出点、收益和风险指标。

payload.name: StrategyTune
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
StrategyTune 是交易策略回测平台，此插件让 ChatGPT 能够直接操作它。

ChatGPT 可以编写并保存构建策略所需的组件，包括图表指标、可复用的市场条件（StrategyTune 称之为信号和过滤器）以及完整交易策略，再在 StrategyTune 的沙盒云环境中，使用真实历史市场数据逐笔运行。简单策略可在数秒内回测一年的历史数据，便于快速迭代。

它不局限于自动策略回测。ChatGPT 还能在同一沙盒中运行自定义研究代码：统计某条件发生的频率、测量特定时刻的数值、收集自己的统计数据，并在运行中记录日志。你说明想检查什么，ChatGPT 编写代码、运行、读取输出，再告诉你发现了什么。

运行结束后，你会获得完整报告，包括绩效统计及其背后的逐笔交易。ChatGPT 还能操作已打开的 StrategyTune 图表：读取 K 线和各指标的计算值，添加并配置指标，在时间轴上标注条件，直观看到条件何时成立，并切换品种或时间周期。读取计算值也有助于它调试自己的工作：若它编写的指标在图表上看起来不对，就能检查曲线背后的实际数字，而非猜测。

一切都基于历史数据运行。此插件不会连接券商、提交实盘订单或提供投资建议。

payload.name: S&P Global - Deterministic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use natural language to query a range of S&P Global datasets, including S&P Capital IQ Financials, transcripts, and more. Designed to save time and resources for engineering, product, and business teams in financial services, this server streamlines access to company information, financial statements, historical market data, and global securities.
payload.longDescription: 用自然语言查询一系列 S&P Global 数据集，包括 S&P Capital IQ Financials、文字稿等。此服务器旨在为金融服务行业的工程、产品和业务团队节省时间与资源，简化公司信息、财务报表、历史市场数据和全球证券的访问。

payload.name: FactSet AI-Ready Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FactSet Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open, API-based standard designed to seamlessly connect financial data, analytics models, and applications across different platforms. By enabling smooth interoperability, MCP empowers investment teams to easily share insights, streamline workflows, and enhance collaboration regardless of their tools or technology stacks. With MCP, firms can integrate new solutions efficiently, drive innovation, and maximize the value of their financial operations—ensuring consistent, context-rich decision-making throughout the investment process.
payload.longDescription: FactSet 模型上下文协议（MCP）是一项开放、基于 API 的标准，旨在顺畅连接不同平台上的金融数据、分析模型和应用。MCP 通过实现顺畅互操作，让投资团队无论采用何种工具或技术栈，都能轻松分享洞察、简化工作流程并加强协作。借助 MCP，公司可高效整合新方案、推动创新，并充分发挥金融业务的价值，确保整个投资流程中的决策一致且拥有丰富的上下文。

payload.name: Mercury
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Mercury account to ChatGPT to get answers about your finances in the same place you’re already doing the rest of your work.
payload.longDescription: 将您的Mercury账户连接至ChatGPT，在您日常处理其他工作的同一平台获取财务相关答案。

payload.name: Remitly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You can use Remitly within Chatgpt to plan your money transfer before you send. You can ask questions about delivery times, fees, rates and more.

Remitly is trusted by millions of customers who rely on it to send money home, donate or have local currency while traveling abroad. Our customers and their recipients are located in over 170 countries across the globe, and Remitly offers 24/7 customer support.

You can try asking:
- What's the best rate for sending 50 usd to India from USA
- What delivery methods are supported sending USA to Mexico?
- Where can I pickup cash near Monterrey, Mexico?
- What's the fastest way to send $399 from USA to Mexico?
payload.longDescription:
你可以在 ChatGPT 内使用 Remitly，在汇款前规划资金转账，询问到账时间、费用、汇率等问题。

数百万客户信赖 Remitly，用它向家乡汇款、捐款，或在境外旅行时获得当地货币。我们的客户及收款人遍布全球超过 170 个国家，Remitly 提供 24/7 客户支持。

你可以试着问：
- 从 USA 向印度汇 50 usd，最优惠的汇率是多少？
- 从 USA 向墨西哥汇款支持哪些收款方式？
- 在墨西哥蒙特雷附近哪里可以领取现金？
- 从 USA 向墨西哥汇 $399，最快的方式是什么？

payload.name: Rallies
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rallies is an AI research app for the stock market, built on live data instead of stale web results. Ask about any US ticker in plain English and get answers backed by real-time prices, fundamentals, earnings, SEC filings, options flow, technicals, analyst actions, insider activity, and hedge fund positioning.

Connect your brokerage to ask questions about your own portfolio; what drove today's move, where your risk concentrates, how a holding compares to its peers — without juggling six tabs or spreadsheets.

What you can do:

Chat with any ticker or your full portfolio
Work from live charts with indicators (RSI, MACD, 20/50 MA)
Analyze earnings history, estimates, and surprises
Screen by price action, fundamentals, or technical setups
Review options flow, darkpool prints, short interest, insider and politician trades
Track your net worth and holdings across connected accounts
Follow AI Arena, where frontier models run live portfolios in public with transparent reasoning

Rallies is a research tool and does not execute trades.
payload.longDescription:
Rallies 是一款股票市场 AI 研究应用，基于实时数据而非过时的网络结果构建。用日常英语询问任意美国股票代码，获得基于实时价格、基本面、财报、SEC 申报文件、期权资金流、技术面、分析师行动、内部人士活动和对冲基金持仓的答案。

连接券商后，可就自己的投资组合提问：今天的波动由什么驱动、风险集中在哪里、某项持仓与同类公司相比如何，无需在六个标签页或电子表格之间切换。

你可以：

就任意股票或整个投资组合对话
使用带指标的实时图表（RSI、MACD、20/50 MA）
分析历史财报、预期与超预期情况
按价格走势、基本面或技术形态筛选
查看期权资金流、暗池成交、空头仓位、内部人士与政客交易
追踪已连接账户的净资产和持仓
关注 AI Arena，前沿模型在这里公开运行实盘投资组合，并透明展示推理过程

Rallies 是研究工具，不执行交易。

payload.name: Intuit TurboTax
payload.description: 税额估算、报税准备及专家服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get fast federal tax estimates and discover filing and preparation options with Intuit TurboTax-powered tools. Use a simple tax estimator or a guided interview to collect what matters, and watch your refund or amount owed update as you go. Get a clear view of the forms and documents you need, what you have, and what is left to gather—then upload securely when you sign in and complete consent when prompted for protected features. Ready for a human? Find trusted tax pros, check real availability, and book an appointment. Confident tax filing starts here.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Intuit TurboTax 支持的工具，快速估算联邦税额，了解申报和报税准备选项。通过简单税额估算器或引导式问答收集重要信息，并在操作过程中查看退税额或应缴税额实时更新。清楚了解所需表格和文件、已经准备好的材料，以及仍需收集的材料——登录后安全上传，并在使用受保护功能收到提示时完成同意授权。需要人工帮助？查找可信赖的税务专业人士，查看实际可预约时间，并预约会面。从这里开始，有把握地报税。

payload.name: Fiscal.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fiscal.ai helps users research public companies through source-linked financial statements, ratios, prices, filings, news, ownership, segments, KPIs, earnings events, and fund letters available under their Fiscal.ai account.
payload.longDescription: Fiscal.ai 帮助用户利用其 Fiscal.ai 账户可访问的、关联来源的财务报表、比率、价格、申报文件、新闻、所有权、业务分部、KPI、财报事件和基金投资者信来研究上市公司。

payload.name: Simply Family Budget
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Simply Family Budget helps households understand what they can actually afford by bringing balances, transactions, budgets, recurring entries, cashflow, and projected balances together. Review and manage your family’s financial records, wallets, categories, and tags directly through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Simply Family Budget 将余额、交易、预算、周期性记录、现金流和预计余额整合起来，帮助家庭了解实际能负担哪些支出。直接通过 ChatGPT 查看和管理家庭财务记录、钱包、分类和标签。

payload.name: LSEG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The LSEG connector provides real-time access to LSEG's comprehensive financial market data ecosystem, spanning across asset classes and domains. It enables seamless integration of institutional-grade market data, analytics and valuation tools directly into conversational AI workflows, allowing users to access deep market insights, perform complex calculations and analyse financial instruments through natural language interactions.
payload.longDescription: LSEG 连接器提供对 LSEG 全面金融市场数据生态的实时访问，覆盖多种资产类别和领域。它将机构级市场数据、分析及估值工具顺畅整合到对话式 AI 工作流中，让用户通过自然语言交互获取深入市场洞察、执行复杂计算，并分析金融工具。

payload.name: Pocket Ledger Expense Tracker
payload.description: 通过聊天跟踪费用和预算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PocketLedger is a personal finance app, expense tracker, spending tracker, and budget tracker inside ChatGPT. Log expenses by chatting, track spending, search your transaction history, spot possible duplicate charges, and get clear spending reports, category reports, financial reports, and monthly budget summaries. It helps with expense management, money management, budget management, and everyday personal finance without spreadsheets or a separate finance app.
payload.longDescription: PocketLedger 是 ChatGPT 内的个人财务应用，可跟踪费用、支出和预算。通过聊天记录费用、跟踪支出、搜索交易历史、发现可能的重复扣款，并获取清晰的支出报告、分类报告、财务报告和月度预算摘要。它帮助您管理费用、资金、预算及日常个人财务，无需电子表格或单独的财务应用。

payload.name: OptionsCalc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OptionsCalc helps you build and visualize options strategies with full Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega), implied volatility, and interactive P/L heatmaps. Describe a trade idea, like 'show me an iron condor on AAPL', and get instant payoff diagrams, risk metrics, and scenario analysis across price and time. Supports multi-leg strategies including spreads, condors, straddles, and butterflies.
payload.longDescription: OptionsCalc 帮助你构建和可视化期权策略，提供完整的希腊字母指标（delta、gamma、theta、vega）、隐含波动率及交互式盈亏热图。描述交易想法，例如“展示 AAPL 的铁鹰策略”，即可即时获得收益图、风险指标，以及随价格和时间变化的情景分析。支持多腿策略，包括价差、鹰式、跨式及蝶式策略。

payload.name: InvestmentIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Set a savings goal and instantly discover how much to invest monthly, how long it will take, or what return rate you need to get there — all in one smart calculator. Choose from Conservative, Moderate, or Aggressive strategies and watch an interactive chart project your wealth up to 50 years into the future. See a clear breakdown of your starting balance, total contributions, and interest earned at a glance. This app is suitable for all ages.
payload.longDescription: 设置储蓄目标，立即了解每月需要投资多少、需要多长时间，或需要什么回报率才能达成目标——全部在一个智能计算器中完成。选择保守、适中或积极策略，通过交互式图表预测未来最长 50 年的财富。清晰分解初始余额、累计投入及赚取的利息，一目了然。此应用适合所有年龄段。

payload.name: Aiera
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access institutional-grade financial data from Aiera, including live corporate events, filings, company publications, broker research, and much more.
payload.longDescription: 访问 Aiera 的机构级金融数据，包括实时公司活动、申报文件、公司出版物、券商研究等丰富内容。

payload.name: StockLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StockLens scores 9,500+ stocks every night across five domains: Fundamental, Technical, Risk, Sentiment, and Macro. Ask about a stock and get its latest composite score, the domain scores behind it, and the strengths and challenges the scoring run surfaced. The 600 largest companies answer with no StockLens account and no sign-in. Free accounts read those same 600, Pro reads the top 5,000, and Max reads the whole scored universe. Any account also reads every stock on its own watchlist, however deep it ranks.

Find your next idea instead of checking one ticker at a time. Discover Stocks screens the whole nightly-analyzed universe by region, exchange, sector, industry, market cap, or volume and ranks the results by any StockLens score, so "the five highest-scored Technology stocks on NASDAQ" is a single question. Free accounts browse with scores hidden; Pro and Max plans include the ranked results.

Build and manage your own watchlist right from the conversation: add or remove a ticker, then ask how everything on it scored last night. Free tracks up to 10 stocks; Pro and Max plans track an unlimited number.

When one stock matters, start a full analysis on demand, follow its progress, and read the result. Plus Analysis adds an AI narrative and is part of the Pro and Max plans.

Try:
- "How does NVDA score on StockLens?"
- "Show me the five highest-scored Technology stocks on NASDAQ from last night's run"
- "Run a StockLens analysis on GOOGL"
- "Add GOOGL to my StockLens watchlist"
- "How do the stocks on my StockLens watchlist score?"

Analyses, discovery, and your watchlist connect to your StockLens account over OAuth. Plan changes are made by signing in at stocklens.com. For informational and educational purposes only, not investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
StockLens 每晚从五个维度为 9,500+ 只股票评分：基本面、技术面、风险、情绪和宏观。询问某只股票，即可获得最新综合评分、各维度评分，以及本次评分发现的优势和挑战。查询规模最大的 600 家公司无需 StockLens 账户，也无需登录。免费账户可以查看这 600 家公司，Pro 可查看排名前 5,000 家，Max 可查看所有已评分股票。任何账户都能查看自己自选股列表中的每只股票，无论其排名多靠后。

无需逐个检查股票代码，即可寻找下一个投资思路。Discover Stocks 可按地区、交易所、板块、行业、市值或成交量筛选每晚分析的全部股票，并按任意 StockLens 评分排序，因此只需一句“NASDAQ 上评分最高的五只科技股”。免费账户浏览时不显示评分；Pro 和 Max 套餐包含排序结果。

直接在对话中建立和管理自己的自选股列表：添加或移除股票代码，然后询问列表中所有股票昨晚的评分。免费版最多跟踪 10 只股票；Pro 和 Max 套餐不限数量。

当你关注某只股票时，可以按需启动完整分析，跟踪进度并阅读结果。Plus Analysis 增加 AI 文字分析，包含在 Pro 和 Max 套餐中。

试着问：
- “NVDA 在 StockLens 上的评分如何？”
- “给我看看昨晚 NASDAQ 上评分最高的五只科技股”
- “对 GOOGL 运行 StockLens 分析”
- “将 GOOGL 添加到我的 StockLens 自选股列表”
- “我的 StockLens 自选股列表中的股票评分如何？”

分析、股票发现和自选股列表通过 OAuth 连接到你的 StockLens 账户。套餐变更需登录 stocklens.com。仅供信息参考和教育用途，不构成投资建议。

payload.name: Gainium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gainium helps users inspect their trading bot workspace from ChatGPT through a read-only connector. Users can list and review bots, deals, account balances, connected exchanges, strategy schemas, market screener data, curated presets, and existing backtest request information without creating bots, starting deals, placing trades, or changing account state.
payload.longDescription: Gainium 通过只读连接器帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中查看交易机器人工作区。用户可以列出和查看机器人、交易、账户余额、已连接交易所、策略结构、市场筛选器数据、精选预设及现有回测请求信息，无需创建机器人、启动交易、下单或更改账户状态。

payload.name: Experian Credit Cards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Experian Credit Cards, Experian’s marketplace for credit cards, lets users explore credit card options for various types of user needs directly inside ChatGPT with minimal input. By answering 1 question (type of card user is interested in) users receive relevant credit card offers from Experian’s lending partners. The options are not final, but starting points for comparison. Users can seamlessly continue to Experian to view personalized matches and then proceed to the lender to apply. No personally identifiable information is collected in the ChatGPT experience, and users can skip entering type of card if desired, as these are simply used to help users identify cards that match their credit profile.
payload.longDescription: Experian Credit Cards 是 Experian 的信用卡市场，让用户只需提供极少信息，便可直接在 ChatGPT 中探索满足各种需求的信用卡选项。回答 1 个问题（感兴趣的卡片类型），即可获得 Experian 贷款合作伙伴的相关信用卡优惠。这些选项并非最终方案，而是用于比较的起点。用户可以顺畅转到 Experian 查看个性化匹配，然后进入贷款机构申请。在 ChatGPT 体验中不收集可识别个人身份的信息；用户也可选择跳过填写卡片类型，这些信息仅用于帮助找到符合其信用状况的卡片。

payload.name: Zacks Financial Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use Zacks Investment Research’s trusted data right in your AI chat — and give your AI assistant an edge. Zacks Connect AI is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that plugs the Zacks Rank, estimates, fundamentals, Zacks Investment Research and market news straight into your Claude chat.
Financial reported data, Zacks Ranks, Data history, daily prices, Analyst consensus , reasons to buy, investment ideas.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 AI 聊天中使用 Zacks Investment Research 的可信数据，让你的 AI 助手更具优势。Zacks Connect AI 是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，将 Zacks Rank、预测数据、基本面、Zacks Investment Research 和市场新闻直接接入你的 Claude 聊天。
财务报告数据、Zacks Ranks、历史数据、每日价格、分析师共识、买入理由和投资思路。

payload.name: WealthCheck Financial Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get a complete snapshot of your financial health in seconds. WealthCheck analyzes your income, expenses, savings, and debt to calculate your net worth, savings rate, and monthly spending — then gives you a personalized action plan to improve. Whether you're budgeting for the first time or optimizing an existing plan, see exactly where your money goes and what to do next.
payload.longDescription: 几秒内获得完整的财务健康快照。WealthCheck 分析你的收入、支出、储蓄和债务，计算净资产、储蓄率和每月支出，然后提供个性化行动计划，帮助改善财务状况。无论是第一次编制预算，还是优化现有计划，都能清楚看到资金去向及下一步该做什么。

payload.name: Fold
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fold helps users securely review their own transactions, accounts, investments, recurring expenses, credit profile, and savings through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Fold 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 安全地查看自己的交易、账户、投资、周期性费用、信用状况和储蓄。

payload.name: Brex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Brex helps finance teams and employees review company spend through ChatGPT. Users can look up expenses, cards, limits, users, bills, vendors, and accounting records; analyze spend; attach receipts from HTTPS URLs; update memos and attendees; assign card expenses to limits; export expense data; and submit product feedback.
payload.longDescription: Brex 帮助财务团队和员工通过 ChatGPT 查看公司支出。用户可以查询费用、卡片、额度、用户、账单、供应商和会计记录，分析支出，从 HTTPS URL 附加收据，更新备注及参与人员，将卡片费用分配到额度，导出费用数据，并提交产品反馈。

payload.name: Morningstar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Integrate Morningstar's comprehensive investment data and independent research directly into your AI workflows. Through our MCP-powered connector, clients can explore cross-asset coverage, including funds, equities, and beyond, enhanced by forward-looking insights from our global analyst teams. Access trusted, unbiased intelligence to support investment decisions, due diligence, and portfolio strategy in one seamless experience.
payload.longDescription: 将 Morningstar 全面的投资数据和独立研究直接融入 AI 工作流。通过我们由 MCP 支持的连接器，客户可探索覆盖基金、股票等领域的跨资产数据，并获得全球分析师团队提供的前瞻性洞察。通过无缝体验获取可信、客观的情报，为投资决策、尽职调查和投资组合策略提供支持。

payload.name: Third Bridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Seamlessly incorporate critical context and trusted insights from industry experts as part of your financial and business analysis. Refocus on extracting high-quality, reliable information by querying Third Bridge’s best-in-class substantial Library of expert content and data.

Our MCP systematically and securely instructs Large Language Models (LLMs) to query insights from our database into their systems, streamlining your workflows and improving your output.
payload.longDescription:
将行业专家提供的重要背景和可信洞察无缝融入财务与商业分析。查询 Third Bridge 一流且丰富的专家内容与数据资料库，重新专注于获取高质量、可靠的信息。

我们的 MCP 以系统化、安全的方式引导大型语言模型（LLM）从数据库查询洞察并纳入其系统，简化你的工作流并改善产出。

payload.name: Insurify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Insurify helps you get multiple real-time, personalized car insurance quote estimates from leading insurance companies. Enter a few details about yourself and your vehicle and compare options based on price, payment schedule, and coverage. When you’re ready to buy, you will be redirected to Insurify’s secure website or directly to the selected insurance carrier’s secure platform to complete the application, payment, and policy issuance.

Insurify, Inc. operates the leading national insurance comparison platform, with all insurance agency and quoting functionalities conducted by Insurify Insurance Agency, Inc., a licensed agency partnering with top-tier carriers and insurance professionals to provide excellent consumer service. With Insurify in ChatGPT, you can get fast, personalized auto insurance quote estimates by providing only a few simple details. No purchase is required to get quote estimates.

After purchase, ongoing customer service eligibility is determined by your selected insurance carrier. For qualifying partner carriers, Insurify Insurance Agency, Inc. provides direct customer support, policy adjustments, and account servicing. Please note that all formal insurance claims processing, claims support, and claims management are handled directly by your chosen underwriting insurance carrier.

By chatting with us through ChatGPT, the personal information you provide in this chat will be subject to ChatGPT Terms of Use and Privacy Policy and may be shared with Insurify, Insurify Insurance Agency, Inc., their respective affiliates, participating insurance carriers, insurance professional partners, and service providers for the purpose of providing you with auto insurance quote estimates. Please only share the personal information requested to provide you with quote estimates. Please don’t provide any additional sensitive information. To learn more about how Insurify processes your personal information, please see our privacy policy.
payload.longDescription:
Insurify 帮助你从领先的保险公司获取多份实时、个性化的汽车保险预估报价。输入少量关于你本人及车辆的信息，即可按价格、付款安排和保障范围比较方案。准备购买时，你将跳转到 Insurify 的安全网站，或直接进入所选保险公司的安全平台，完成申请、付款和保单签发。

Insurify, Inc. 运营着领先的全国性保险比较平台，所有保险代理和报价功能均由 Insurify Insurance Agency, Inc. 提供。这是一家持牌代理机构，与一流保险公司和保险专业人士合作，为消费者提供优质服务。通过 ChatGPT 中的 Insurify，只需提供少量简单信息，即可快速获得个性化汽车保险预估报价。获取预估报价无需购买。

购买后，你是否可享受持续客户服务，由所选保险公司决定。对于符合条件的合作保险公司，Insurify Insurance Agency, Inc. 提供直接客户支持、保单调整和账户服务。请注意，所有正式保险理赔处理、理赔支持和理赔管理均由你选择的承保保险公司直接负责。

通过 ChatGPT 与我们交流时，你在此次对话中提供的个人信息将受 ChatGPT 使用条款和隐私政策约束，并可能与 Insurify、Insurify Insurance Agency, Inc.、各自关联公司、参与的保险公司、保险专业合作伙伴及服务提供商共享，以便向你提供汽车保险预估报价。请仅提供为获取预估报价而要求的个人信息。请勿提供额外的敏感信息。如需了解 Insurify 如何处理你的个人信息，请参阅我们的隐私政策。

payload.name: Manilo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your personal finance advisor, with your full ledger at hand. Log expenses by voice, photo, or chat and let Manilo categorize them. Set budgets per category or period and stay on track with proactive checks. Plan recurring income and expenses, and track your spending across any timeframe. Ask "am I overspending on dining this month?" or "how much can I afford to save in Q3?" and get advice grounded in your real data — not generic tips. 30+ tools covering accounts, transactions, budgets, categories, and receipts. Personally owned. Shareable when you want.
payload.longDescription: 你的个人财务顾问，随时掌握完整账本。通过语音、照片或聊天记录支出，让 Manilo 自动分类。按类别或期间设置预算，通过主动检查保持计划进度。规划经常性收入和支出，并跟踪任意时间范围的花费。询问“本月餐饮支出是否超了？”或“Q3 我能存下多少钱？”，获得基于真实数据的建议，而非通用小贴士。30+ 个工具涵盖账户、交易、预算、类别及收据。由你个人拥有，想分享时也可分享。

payload.name: Fakturoid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Issue invoices in Fakturoid, record expenses, or analyze your business data and statistics.
payload.longDescription: 在 Fakturoid 中开具发票、记录费用，或分析业务数据与统计。

payload.name: MoonPay
payload.description: 用信用卡购买加密货币
payload.summaryOriginal: Buy crypto with a credit card
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Buying crypto used to mean leaving your conversation, opening a separate tab, hunting for the right token, and pasting wallet addresses. MoonPay does it from inside ChatGPT. Tell the app what you want "USDC on Solana", "0.1 ETH", "$100 of Bitcoin" and it generates a ready-to-go checkout link in seconds. Click through to moonpay.com, pay with a card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or bank transfer, and the crypto lands in your wallet.

No new account needed if you already have a MoonPay account. The app fills in the asset, chain, and amount; you confirm the rest at the moonpay.com checkout.

Supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, USDC, and 100+ other assets across 30+ chains.

About this app. Buy-link generation only, no funds move or transactions execute inside ChatGPT. All payment activity, KYC, and regulatory controls happen at moonpay.com under MoonPay's licensed entities. Cryptoasset values can rise and fall significantly and your capital is at risk. Supported countries and assets are governed by your KYC outcome and MoonPay's licensing in your jurisdiction.
payload.longDescription:
以前，购买加密货币需要离开对话、打开新标签页、查找正确的代币并粘贴钱包地址。MoonPay 让您在 ChatGPT 内完成这些准备。告诉应用您想买什么，例如“Solana 上的 USDC”、“0.1 ETH”或“价值 $100 的 Bitcoin”，几秒内就会生成可直接使用的结账链接。点击进入 moonpay.com，用银行卡、Apple Pay、Google Pay 或银行转账付款，加密货币便会转入您的钱包。

如果您已有 MoonPay 账户，无需创建新账户。应用会填入资产、链和金额；其余内容由您在 moonpay.com 结账时确认。

支持 Bitcoin、Ethereum、Solana、USDC，以及覆盖 30+ 条链的 100+ 种其他资产。

关于此应用：仅生成购买链接，ChatGPT 内不会转移资金或执行交易。所有支付活动、KYC 和监管控制均在 moonpay.com 上由 MoonPay 的持牌实体执行。加密资产价值可能大幅上涨或下跌，您的本金面临风险。支持的国家和资产取决于您的 KYC 结果，以及 MoonPay 在您所在司法辖区的许可范围。

payload.name: CloFin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CloFin is your intelligent personal financial assistant. Manage your financial life through natural conversations: log expenses, track budgets, check account balances, and organize your financial categories quickly, securely, and automatically.
payload.longDescription: CloFin 是智能个人财务助手。通过自然对话管理财务生活：记录费用、追踪预算、查看账户余额，并快速、安全、自动地整理财务类别。

payload.name: Expensify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask questions about your Expensify account and get answers from your real data — not guesses.

Connect your Expensify account and ask natural language questions about your finances. ChatGPT will query your actual account to answer them.

What you can ask:

- "How much did I spend on travel last quarter?"
- "Which team members have unsubmitted expense reports?"
- "Show me all approved expenses that haven't been reimbursed yet."
- "Find my receipts from Uber over the past 30 days."
- "Which categories am I spending the most on this month?"

Read-only. This plugin never creates, modifies, or deletes anything in your account.
payload.longDescription:
询问您的 Expensify 账户，获得基于真实数据而非猜测的答案。

连接 Expensify 账户，用自然语言询问财务问题。ChatGPT 会查询您的实际账户来回答。

您可以问：

- “我上个季度在差旅上花了多少钱？”
- “哪些团队成员有尚未提交的费用报告？”
- “显示所有已获批准但尚未报销的费用。”
- “查找过去 30 天的 Uber 收据。”
- “这个月哪些类别的支出最多？”

仅提供只读访问。此插件绝不会创建、修改或删除账户中的任何内容。

payload.name: Financial Summarizer Pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reading SEC filings is time-consuming. Financial Summarizer Pro does it for you. 

Type any US ticker symbol and the app retrieves the company's latest annual and quarterly filings from SEC EDGAR, extracts the key financial data, and presents it as a clean, structured summary — the kind an analyst would put together, in a fraction of the time.
payload.longDescription:
阅读 SEC 披露文件很耗时。Financial Summarizer Pro 帮你完成这项工作。

输入任意美国股票代码，应用便会从 SEC EDGAR 获取该公司最新的年度及季度披露文件，提取关键财务数据，并呈现为清晰、结构化的摘要——就像分析师整理的内容，但耗时只是其中一小部分。

payload.name: PortfolioIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Visualize a portfolio's growth potential with advanced simulation technology. 

Run unlimited projections across stocks, bonds, crypto, real estate, and more. 

Adjust asset allocation, time horizon, and contributions to see portfolio forecasts within confidence intervals.
payload.longDescription:
利用先进模拟技术，直观了解投资组合的增长潜力。

对股票、债券、加密资产、房地产等进行不限次数的预测。

调整资产配置、投资期限和投入金额，查看带置信区间的投资组合预测。

payload.name: Razorpay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Razorpay account to access your payment data through conversation.
Ask ChatGPT about your payments, orders, refunds, settlements, QR codes, payment links etc. Get instant answers to questions like "Show me today's payments," "What's the status of my recent settlements," or "Find refunds from last week."
Perfect for merchants who want quick insights without navigating dashboards. View transaction details, track settlement timelines, check saved payment methods, and analyze your payment activity—all through natural language.

What you can do:
1. Retrieve payment and order details
2. Check refund and settlement status
3. View QR code and payment link activity
4. Track payouts and reconciliation data
5. Access saved customer payment methods

Read-only access—your data stays secure, and no transactions are executed through this app.
payload.longDescription:
连接您的 Razorpay 账户，通过对话访问支付数据。
向 ChatGPT 查询付款、订单、退款、结算、二维码、支付链接等信息。即时回答“显示今天的付款”、“最近结算的状态如何”或“查找上周的退款”等问题。
适合希望快速获取洞察、无需浏览仪表盘的商户。通过自然语言查看交易详情、跟踪结算时间、检查已保存的付款方式，以及分析支付活动。

您可以：
1. 获取付款和订单详情
2. 检查退款和结算状态
3. 查看二维码和支付链接活动
4. 跟踪转出付款和对账数据
5. 访问已保存的客户付款方式

仅提供只读访问——您的数据保持安全，此应用不会执行任何交易。

payload.name: Elevate Invoices
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stop manually filling out invoice forms. This app creates invoices with intelligent defaults: it recognizes your clients, remembers your pricing, and auto-fills details from previous invoices. Just tell ChatGPT what you need, and it handles the rest. View, update, and manage all your invoices in one place.
payload.longDescription: 无需再手工填写发票表格。此应用利用智能默认值创建发票：识别客户、记住定价，并根据此前发票自动填充细节。只需告诉 ChatGPT 你的需求，剩下的交给它。在一处查看、更新和管理所有发票。

payload.name: Crunchbase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trusted private market intelligence, right inside your conversation.

Crunchbase MCP brings private market data and predictive signals into the AI tools and agents you already use. Built for investors, go-to-market teams, product builders, and anyone else who needs answers, not just search results.

Ask in plain English. No code, no technical training. The MCP figures out the filters, fields, and connections you might not have known to ask for, and returns a complete, sourced answer. Most other MCP servers only offer raw search and list data.

Supercharge your workflow. Identify high-growth companies, run diligence in seconds, and act on opportunities before other firms catch on, or give your customers foresight into market movements directly in your product, without the engineering lift.

Build lists you can return to. Save companies as you find them. A search today becomes a pipeline you monitor over time.

Predictions you can act on. Forecasts of what a company is likely to do next such as: funding, acquisition, IPO, growth, shutdown, or headcount cuts, plus an estimated current valuation. Every prediction carries a confidence tier, so you can rank an entire market by likelihood instead of reading profiles one at a time. Powered by 15M+ predictions refreshed weekly.

Why Crunchbase? The only dataset combining the aggregated activity of 80M users, 1,000+ public sources, and 600k+ data team members, VC partners, and subject-matter experts.
payload.longDescription:
在对话中直接获取可信的私募市场情报。

Crunchbase MCP 将私募市场数据和预测信号引入您已经使用的 AI 工具和智能体。它面向投资者、市场拓展团队、产品开发者，以及其他需要答案而不只是搜索结果的人。

用日常英语提问。无需编程或技术培训。MCP 会确定您可能尚未想到的筛选条件、字段和关联关系，并返回完整且注明来源的答案。大多数其他 MCP 服务器只提供原始搜索和列表数据。

提升工作效率。识别高增长企业，几秒内完成尽职调查，在其他公司发现之前抓住机会；或者直接在您的产品中向客户提供市场走势前瞻，无需投入繁重的工程开发。

建立可反复查看的列表。发现企业时即可保存。今天的搜索结果可以成为您持续监测的项目管线。

获得可据以行动的预测。预测企业下一步可能的动向，例如融资、收购、IPO、增长、停业或裁员，并提供当前估值的估计。每项预测均标注置信度等级，让您能够按发生概率对整个市场排序，而不是逐一阅读企业资料。由每周更新的 15M+ 项预测提供支持。

为什么选择 Crunchbase？这是唯一结合 80M 用户的汇总活动、1,000+ 个公开来源，以及 600k+ 名数据团队成员、风投合作伙伴和领域专家信息的数据集。

payload.name: The Fly Market Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Fly Market Intelligence provides read-only tools to research companies, analyze earnings and catalysts, build market briefs, discover symbols, search and retrieve financial news, and screen stocks.
payload.longDescription: The Fly Market Intelligence 提供只读工具，用于研究公司、分析财报和催化因素、编制市场简报、查找证券代码、搜索和检索财经新闻，以及筛选股票。

payload.name: Tuio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tuio helps users in Spain estimate home insurance prices, review included coverage, continue a quote on Tuio, and search FAQ or policy terms for insurance support questions.
payload.longDescription: Tuio 帮助西班牙用户估算住宅保险价格、查看包含的保障、在 Tuio 上继续获取报价，并搜索常见问题或保单条款，解答保险支持问题。

payload.name: RealEstateIQ
payload.description: 现金流和投资回报率分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Know if a rental or investment property is worth it before you make an offer. Plug in your numbers and instantly get cash-on-cash return, cap rate, NOI, IRR, and a full 20-year profit projection. Simple enough for first-time investors, powerful enough for seasoned landlords. This app is suitable for all ages.
payload.longDescription: 在出价之前，了解出租房产或投资房产是否值得购买。输入你的数据，即可即时获得现金回报率、资本化率、净营业收入（NOI）、内部收益率（IRR）和完整的 20 年利润预测。对首次投资者足够简单，对经验丰富的房东也足够强大。此应用适合所有年龄段。

payload.name: Experian Loans
payload.description: 快速获取个人贷款估算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Experian Loans brings a seamless personal loan shopping experience to ChatGPT. Users can explore personalized loan estimates from Experian’s lender network, compare available offers, and continue directly to a lender’s website to complete an application. Estimates are provided as starting points for comparison and do not represent final loan offers, approvals, rates, or terms.
payload.longDescription: Experian Loans 将顺畅的个人贷款选购体验带入 ChatGPT。用户可以探索 Experian 贷款机构网络提供的个性化贷款估算、比较现有方案，并直接进入贷款机构网站完成申请。估算仅作为比较的起点，不代表最终贷款报价、批准、利率或条款。

payload.name: Plymouth Rock Home Assurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get a Plymouth Rock Assurance home insurance quote estimate directly in ChatGPT. Provide your name, property address, and date of birth to check eligibility and receive a personalized quote estimate for eligible homes in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. If eligible, you'll be directed to Plymouth Rock Assurance's secure quoting platform to customize coverage, complete your application, and purchase your policy. Plymouth Rock provides customer service, claims support, and policy management after purchase.

No purchase is required to receive a quote. Information you provide through ChatGPT is subject to ChatGPT's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy and may be shared with Plymouth Rock Group of Companies and authorized service providers for the purpose of generating your quote. Only provide the information requested for quoting. For more information, see Plymouth Rock's Privacy Policy and Information Disclosure.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中获取 Plymouth Rock Assurance 房屋保险报价估算。提供姓名、房产地址和出生日期，即可检查资格，并为位于马萨诸塞州、新罕布什尔州、康涅狄格州、纽约州、新泽西州和宾夕法尼亚州且符合条件的房屋获取个性化报价估算。如符合条件，您将被引导至 Plymouth Rock Assurance 的安全报价平台，以定制保障、完成申请并购买保单。购买后，Plymouth Rock 提供客户服务、理赔支持和保单管理。

获取报价无需购买。您通过 ChatGPT 提供的信息受 ChatGPT 使用条款和隐私政策约束，并可能与 Plymouth Rock Group of Companies 及授权服务提供商共享，以生成您的报价。请仅提供报价所需的信息。更多信息请参阅 Plymouth Rock 的隐私政策和信息披露。

payload.name: Learn to invest with AJ Bell
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Learn to invest with AJ Bell in ChatGPT helps you build your investing knowledge through a simple, natural conversation. Explore clear, educational content from AJ Bell’s Learn to Invest library, read helpful articles and Shares Magazine content, and get straightforward explanations of investing terms and jargon, all without leaving ChatGPT. Whether you’re learning the basics, exploring different investment ideas, or trying to understand market language, Learn to Invest with AJ Bell makes it easier to find trusted educational content and answers to your investing questions. This experience is for information purposes only and is not a personal recommendation or advice.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT 中的 Learn to invest with AJ Bell 通过简单、自然的对话帮助你积累投资知识。探索 AJ Bell 的 Learn to Invest 资料库中清晰的教育内容，阅读实用文章和 Shares Magazine 内容，并获取投资术语及行话的直白解释，全程无需离开 ChatGPT。无论是在学习基础知识、探索不同投资思路，还是试图理解市场用语，Learn to Invest with AJ Bell 都能让你更容易找到可信的教育内容和投资问题的答案。此体验仅用于提供信息，不构成个性化推荐或建议。

payload.name: CB Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Unleash ChatGPT as your private markets research agent. Source companies, build market maps, draft investment memos, and monitor competitors — all powered by CB Insights’ predictive intelligence. Tap into 11M+ double-validated company profiles, leading coverage of recent equity deals, proprietary taxonomies, unique scores, hidden signals, and over 20 years of bleeding edge technology research to identify and analyze relevant, high-potential companies ahead of your competition.

Built for corporate strategists seeking acquisition targets, VCs screening deal flow, and business development teams hunting new partners. If your work involves private companies, CB Insights delivers the insight you need to make your next move first.
payload.longDescription:
让 ChatGPT 成为你的私募市场研究智能体。发现公司、构建市场图谱、起草投资备忘录和监测竞争对手——全部由 CB Insights 的预测情报支持。利用超过 11M 份经过双重验证的公司档案、对近期股权交易的领先覆盖、专有分类体系、独特评分、隐蔽信号以及超过 20 年的前沿技术研究，抢在竞争对手之前识别和分析相关且潜力巨大的公司。

专为寻找收购目标的企业战略人员、筛选投资项目的风投机构，以及寻觅新合作伙伴的业务拓展团队打造。如果你的工作涉及非上市公司，CB Insights 提供所需洞察，让你抢先采取下一步行动。

payload.name: Portfolio Dividend Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Portfolio Dividend Tracker helps users review portfolio holdings and performance, inspect market and cash-flow data, and manage transactions, dividends, expenses, bookings, cash corrections, and investment strategies through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Portfolio Dividend Tracker 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看投资组合持仓和表现、检查市场与现金流数据，以及管理交易、股息、费用、记账、现金修正和投资策略。

payload.name: Daloopa
payload.description: 附来源链接的财务关键指标
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Daloopa supplies high quality fundamental data sourced from filings, investor presentations, earnings transcripts and company presentations, with hyperlinks to source document overlaying each data point. Provides a zero-hallucination foundation for any quantitative financial analysis in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Daloopa 提供来自申报文件、投资者演示文稿、业绩会议转录和公司演示文稿的高质量基本面数据，每个数据点均附有原始文档的超链接。为 ChatGPT 中的任何定量财务分析提供无幻觉的数据基础。

payload.name: MSCI Connector
payload.description: 查询 MSCI 投资数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MSCI Connector lets authorized users query entitlement-controlled MSCI index, private capital, portfolio, and real-assets data in natural language, including performance, benchmarks, holdings, exposures, constituents, and methodology insights.
payload.longDescription: MSCI Connector 让获授权用户以自然语言查询受访问权益控制的 MSCI 指数、私募资本、投资组合及实物资产数据，包括表现、基准、持仓、风险敞口、成分及方法论洞察。

payload.name: Rabbu
payload.description: 查找待售 Airbnb 房产等信息
payload.summaryOriginal: Find Airbnbs for sale and more
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rabbu helps short-term rental investors find Airbnb properties for sale, analyze real market performance, and make smarter buy decisions. Explore listings, compare markets, estimate revenue, and connect with experienced agents and lenders—all in one place. Designed for clarity and data-driven investing, not hype.
payload.longDescription: Rabbu 帮助短租投资者寻找待售 Airbnb 房产、分析真实市场表现，并做出更明智的购买决策。在同一个地方浏览房源、比较市场、估算收入，并联系经验丰富的经纪人和贷款机构。旨在提供清晰信息并支持数据驱动的投资，而非炒作。

payload.name: Finhay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Vietnam's financial markets through Finhay Securities' infrastructure. Get stock prices across HOSE, HNX, and UPCOM, dive into company financials: income statements, balance sheets, cash flow..., and track macroeconomic indicators, FX rates, gold, and commodity prices. Monitor your portfolio performance, review order history, and analyze holdings by sector or asset class. Built for investors who want to research, analyze, and act on Vietnam's market. All through conversation.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Finhay Securities 的基础设施访问越南金融市场。获取 HOSE、HNX 和 UPCOM 的股价，深入查看企业财务数据：利润表、资产负债表、现金流等，并跟踪宏观经济指标、汇率、黄金及大宗商品价格。监测投资组合表现，查看订单历史，并按行业或资产类别分析持仓。面向希望研究、分析并参与越南市场的投资者。全部通过对话完成。

payload.name: TraderSpy
payload.description: 加密货币信号和鲸鱼数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TraderSpy connects ChatGPT to live crypto futures data, so you can ask about the market instead of tab-hopping between exchanges.

Ask what the AI signal engine has published for a coin and you get the entry, the take-profit ladder, the stop and what actually happened to earlier signals — not just a direction. Ask what the whales are doing and you get real positions held by top-performing traders on Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit and OKX, plus a leaderboard scored on PnL, win rate, ROI and consistency. Prices, candles and 13 technical indicators are one question away, and with your own account connected you can ask how far a position sits from liquidation.

Every tool is read-only. TraderSpy cannot place, close or modify an order and has no withdrawal or transfer tool — it answers questions, you place your own trades. A free account is enough to start.
payload.longDescription:
TraderSpy 将 ChatGPT 连接到实时加密货币期货数据，让你直接询问市场情况，无需在不同交易所标签页间切换。

询问 AI 信号引擎对某个币种发布了什么，即可获得入场价、分级止盈价、止损价，以及此前信号的实际结果，而不仅仅是交易方向。询问鲸鱼在做什么，即可获得 Binance、Hyperliquid、Bybit 和 OKX 上表现优异交易者的真实持仓，以及根据盈亏、胜率、ROI 和稳定性评分的排行榜。只需一句提问，就能获取价格、K 线和 13 个技术指标；连接自己的账户后，还能询问持仓距离强制平仓有多远。

每个工具都是只读的。TraderSpy 无法下单、平仓或修改订单，也没有提现或转账工具——它回答问题，交易由你自己执行。免费账户即可开始使用。

payload.name: AIXBT
payload.description: 加密货币情报与市场叙事
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research crypto intel and narratives.
payload.longDescription: 研究加密货币情报与市场叙事。

payload.name: Double
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Double manages the month-end close. It replaces spreadsheets and scattered checklists with a single system connected to your GL or ERP: tasks, team assignments, and close status all in one place.

Connect it to ChatGPT and you can act on your close without switching apps. Create and reassign tasks, turn meeting notes into action items, and draft status updates for your team or clients, with changes writing back to Double in real time. You control what ChatGPT can read or update in your account.

Works with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct. Built for bookkeepers, accountants, and finance teams running the month-end close.
payload.longDescription:
Double 管理月末结账。它以连接总账（GL）或 ERP 的统一系统取代电子表格和分散的检查清单，将任务、团队分工和结账状态汇总到一处。

连接到 ChatGPT 后，无需切换应用即可处理结账工作。创建和重新分配任务，将会议笔记转为行动事项，并为团队或客户起草状态更新；更改会实时写回 Double。你可以控制 ChatGPT 能读取或更新账户中的哪些内容。

支持 QuickBooks、Xero、NetSuite 和 Sage Intacct。专为执行月末结账的记账人员、会计师及财务团队打造。

payload.name: Dakota Marketplace
payload.description: 搜索资产配置机构和基金
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dakota Marketplace helps users research allocator organizations, contacts, marketplace searches, fundraising news, private-market strategies, transactions, funds, and performance benchmarks through read-only searches.
payload.longDescription: Dakota Marketplace 帮助用户通过只读搜索，研究资产配置机构、联系人、市场搜索、募资新闻、私募市场策略、交易、基金和业绩基准。

payload.name: XE Currency Converter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: XE Currency Converter handles any request to convert money between currencies, check a live exchange rate, or compare currency values. Use it for prompts like 'convert 100 USD to EUR', 'how much is 50 usd in inr', "what's the GBP to JPY rate right now", or '250 dollars in rupees' — with or without an explicit amount, and with currency codes in any case or written as names. Returns the converted amount and the current mid-market exchange rate.
payload.longDescription: XE Currency Converter 处理货币之间的金额换算、实时汇率查询或币值比较请求。可用于“将 100 USD 换算为 EUR”、“50 usd 等于多少 inr”、“现在 GBP 对 JPY 的汇率是多少”或“250 美元折合多少卢比”等提示——无论是否明确给出金额，货币代码使用任何大小写，或用货币名称书写，都可以处理。返回换算金额和当前市场中间汇率。

payload.name: Liberty Mutual
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get a Liberty Mutual Insurance quote estimate with Liberty Mutual-powered tools. Enter a few details to receive customized auto quote estimates. When you’re ready to buy, you will be redirected to Liberty Mutual’s secure website to complete the application, payment, and policy issuance. After purchase, Liberty Mutual provides full customer service, claims support, and policy management. 

Liberty Mutual is a leading national property & casualty insurer offering dependable auto insurance backed by decades of financial strength and customer service. With Liberty Mutual through ChatGPT you can get a fast, personalized auto insurance quote estimate by providing only a few simple details. 

No purchase is required to get estimates. By chatting with us through ChatGPT, the personal information you provide in this chat will be subject to ChatGPT Terms of Use and Privacy Policy and may be shared with Liberty Mutual, affiliates and service providers for the purpose of providing you with an auto insurance quote estimate. Please only share the personal information requested to the questions Liberty Mutual asks for providing you with a quote estimate. Please don’t provide any additional sensitive personal information. To learn more about how Liberty Mutual processes your personal information, please see our privacy policy.
payload.longDescription:
使用 Liberty Mutual 提供支持的工具，获取 Liberty Mutual Insurance 的报价估算。输入少量信息，即可获得个性化汽车保险报价估算。准备购买时，您将跳转到 Liberty Mutual 的安全网站，完成申请、付款和保单签发。购买后，Liberty Mutual 提供完整的客户服务、理赔支持和保单管理。

Liberty Mutual 是美国领先的财产与意外伤害保险公司，凭借数十年的财务实力和客户服务经验，提供可靠的汽车保险。通过 ChatGPT 使用 Liberty Mutual，只需提供几项简单信息，就能快速获得个性化汽车保险报价估算。

获取估算无需购买。通过 ChatGPT 与我们对话时，您在聊天中提供的个人信息受 ChatGPT 使用条款和隐私政策约束，并可能与 Liberty Mutual、其关联公司及服务提供商共享，用于为您提供汽车保险报价估算。请仅提供 Liberty Mutual 为生成报价估算而提出的问题所要求的个人信息。请勿提供额外的敏感个人信息。要了解 Liberty Mutual 如何处理您的个人信息，请参阅我们的隐私政策。

payload.name: Kick
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kick MCP connects ChatGPT to your books across your businesses and clients. Read your financials, categorize transactions, post journal entries, and close the books faster. ChatGPT drafts, you review and approve with confidence.
payload.longDescription: Kick MCP将ChatGPT连接到您企业及客户的账簿中，可查看财务数据、分类交易、记录会计分录并更快完成结账流程。ChatGPT负责起草内容，您只需审核并放心批准。

payload.name: RetirementIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get a fast, clear snapshot of how prepared you are for retirement—based on your age, income, and current savings. See an easy retirement “score,” an on-track status, and the key numbers to focus on next. Free to use right now for a limited time.
payload.longDescription: 根据年龄、收入和当前储蓄，快速清晰地了解你的退休准备程度。查看易于理解的退休“评分”、是否按计划推进的状态，以及接下来应关注的关键数字。目前限时免费使用。

payload.name: Buy Or Rent Simulator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. It provides a complete financial breakdown from your first mortgage payment to the final resale, ensuring you stay objective based on your unique project.

Key features:
- Uses country-specific IMF inflation data for realistic long-term projections
- Compares the cost of buying with potential returns of alternative investments (stock market, savings, etc.)
- No account or registration required — start simulating immediately
- Toggle advanced parameters and view a full amortization table to understand every payment of your mortgage

Adjustable parameters:
- Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.
payload.longDescription:
通过全面的买房与租房模拟器，作出充分知情的房地产决策。此应用提供客观、数据驱动的分析，判断购买房产是否确实比租房并将资金投向其他用途更划算。

模拟器结合你所在国家的 IMF 历史及预测通胀数据，逐年跟踪资金的实际价值。从首次偿还房贷到最终转售，它提供完整的财务分解，让你依据自身具体项目保持客观判断。

主要功能：
- 使用各国 IMF 通胀数据，进行贴近实际的长期预测
- 比较买房成本与其他投资（股市、储蓄等）的潜在回报
- 无需账户或注册，即可立即开始模拟
- 切换高级参数并查看完整摊还表，了解每笔房贷还款

可调整参数：
- 房产：购入价格、公证费、装修成本及中介费
- 融资：首付、贷款期限、房贷利率、保险及提前还款罚金
- 租赁：月租金及预计年度租金涨幅
- 市场逻辑：转售时间、各国通胀率（IMF）及其他投资收益率
- 成本：当地房产税及维护费用

获取清晰、直观的盈亏平衡点报告，准确了解何时持有房产开始带来收益。

payload.name: Western Union
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Track your Western Union money transfers, get official answers to common questions, and check real-time exchange rates. All directly inside ChatGPT.

You can try these right now:

* Track my transfer
* Exchange Rate from USD to INR
* What information do I need to send money?
* What is an MTCN and where can I find it?
* How can I pay for a money transfer?
payload.longDescription:
追踪你的 Western Union 汇款，获取常见问题的官方解答，并查询实时汇率。全部直接在 ChatGPT 内完成。

现在就可以试试：

* 追踪我的汇款

* 汇款需要哪些信息？

* 我可以如何支付汇款费用？

payload.name: Guidepoint
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Embed trusted expert insights directly into your research and decision-making workflows in real-time. Powered by Guidepoint's comprehensive and expanding Library of over 120,000+ compliance-reviewed expert interview transcripts. We combine institutional-grade quality with the volume needed for decision-critical work.
payload.longDescription: 将可信的专家见解实时融入研究和决策工作流。由 Guidepoint 持续扩展的全面资料库提供支持，其中包含超过 120,000+ 份经过合规审核的专家访谈转录。我们将机构级质量与关键决策工作所需的信息规模结合。

payload.name: Mckenzie Adams Credit Repair
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get credit repair help from McKenzie Adams — explore services, pricing, FAQs, business credit, AI disputes, and request a free consultation
payload.longDescription: 获取 McKenzie Adams 的信用修复帮助——探索服务、价格、常见问题、企业信用和 AI 异议申诉，并申请免费咨询

payload.name: Options Analysis Suite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Options Analysis Suite lets users research options markets and review their synced analysis data in ChatGPT. It supports implied volatility, Greeks, options chains, gamma exposure and regime analysis, FINRA and SEC market-structure data, company fundamentals, pricing-analysis history, FFT scanner results, AI Compute Suite runs, and portfolio and risk snapshots. All tools are read-only and return analyst-oriented summaries for research workflows.
payload.longDescription: Options Analysis Suite 让用户在 ChatGPT 中研究期权市场并查看同步的分析数据。支持隐含波动率、希腊值、期权链、伽马敞口及市场状态分析、FINRA 和 SEC 市场结构数据、企业基本面、定价分析历史、FFT 扫描器结果、AI Compute Suite 运行结果，以及投资组合和风险快照。所有工具均为只读，并为研究工作流程返回面向分析师的摘要。

payload.name: LendingTree
REPSLog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
REPSLog helps real estate professionals log and review the work hours that count toward Real Estate Professional Status (REPS) for U.S. tax purposes. Connect your REPSLog account and you can add a time log in plain language (for example, "log 2 hours showing the Oak Street property today"), then ask for your hours back by property, category, participant, or date range.

The connector can create a time log and read your existing data: list your properties, categories, and participants, pull individual logs, and get summaries of total hours. Everything is scoped to your own authenticated REPSLog account. It does not access or share other users' data.

Requires a REPSLog account with an active Premium subscription. That subscription is purchased separately in the standalone REPSLog mobile and web apps, not through ChatGPT. Logs created here sync to those apps, so your records stay in one place for IRS documentation.
payload.longDescription:
REPSLog 帮助房地产专业人士记录和查看计入美国税务用途的房地产专业人士身份（Real Estate Professional Status，REPS）的工作时数。连接 REPSLog 账户后，你可以用自然语言添加工时记录（例如“记录今天带人看 Oak Street 房产的 2 小时”），然后按房产、类别、参与者或日期范围查询工时。

该连接器可以创建工时记录并读取现有数据：列出你的房产、类别和参与者，获取单条记录，以及汇总总工时。所有操作均限于你自己经过身份验证的 REPSLog 账户。它不会访问或共享其他用户的数据。

需要拥有已开通 Premium 订阅的 REPSLog 账户。该订阅需在独立的 REPSLog 手机和网页应用中另行购买，而不是通过 ChatGPT 购买。在此创建的记录会同步至这些应用，让记录集中保存在一处，供 IRS 税务材料留存使用。

payload.name: Affirm
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Affirm lets you pay for purchases over time in fixed installments with no late fees. Use this app to understand how Affirm works, see sample monthly payments for a purchase amount, and start an Affirm purchase when you're ready to buy.
payload.longDescription: Affirm 让你以固定分期逐步支付购物款，不收取逾期费用。使用此应用了解 Affirm 的运作方式，查看指定购买金额的月供示例，并在准备购买时开始 Affirm 购物流程。

payload.name: ForInvest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Forinvest MCP: Real-Time Market Intelligence & Trading Integration

Connect your AI assistant directly to the heartbeat of global financial markets. The Forinvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) app transforms ChatGPT into a powerful financial agent with 22 MCP tools, providing secure, low-latency access to:

Live Market Data: Instant access to BIST, VIOP, global indices, commodities, and crypto prices.

Advanced Analytics: Professional-grade technical analysis tools and financial indicators at your fingertips.

Smart Portfolio Insights: Seamlessly retrieve and analyze portfolio data with institutional precision.

Seamless Connectivity: Built on the MCP standard for secure, bidirectional communication between ChatGPT and Forinvest's robust financial infrastructure.

Whether you're tracking real-time price movements or seeking deep market analysis, Forinvest MCP provides the reliable data layer needed for informed decision-making.

We provide a next-generation financial ecosystem, offering real-time Borsa Istanbul (BIST) data, AI-driven stock analysis, and comprehensive financial tools. Our platform streamlines investment processes by integrating deep-dive balance sheet metrics, brokerage expectations, and instant access to public disclosure (KAP) documents.

Data collected: ForInvest account credentials (for OAuth authentication), symbol codes and date ranges you query, and session identifiers. Tool inputs and outputs are not stored beyond the active session. Financial data returned by tools is sent back to ChatGPT for display. No personal data is sold or used for advertising.

Privacy Policy: https://mcp.forinvest.com/privacy.html
payload.longDescription:
Forinvest MCP：实时市场情报与交易集成

将你的 AI 助手直接连接到全球金融市场的脉动。Forinvest MCP（模型上下文协议）应用利用 22 个 MCP 工具，将 ChatGPT 变成强大的金融智能体，为以下内容提供安全、低延迟的访问：

实时市场数据：即时获取 BIST、VIOP、全球指数、大宗商品和加密货币价格。

高级分析：随时使用专业级技术分析工具和金融指标。

智能投资组合洞察：以机构级精度顺畅获取和分析投资组合数据。

无缝连接：基于 MCP 标准，在 ChatGPT 与 Forinvest 强大的金融基础设施之间建立安全的双向通信。

无论是跟踪实时价格变动，还是寻求深入市场分析，Forinvest MCP 都能提供可靠的数据层，支持有依据的决策。

我们提供新一代金融生态系统，包括实时 Borsa Istanbul（BIST，伊斯坦布尔证券交易所）数据、AI 驱动的股票分析及全面的金融工具。平台整合深入的资产负债表指标、券商预期和即时访问公开披露（KAP）文件的能力，简化投资流程。

收集的数据：ForInvest 账户凭据（用于 OAuth 身份验证）、你查询的证券代码和日期范围，以及会话标识符。工具输入和输出不会在当前会话结束后继续保存。工具返回的金融数据会发送回 ChatGPT 以供展示。不出售个人数据，也不将其用于广告。

隐私政策：https://mcp.forinvest.com/privacy.html

payload.name: Klardaten DATEV-Connector
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Klardaten DATEV-Connector gives authorized users controlled access to DATEV accounting, payroll (Lohn und Gehalt and LODAS), document management, order management, and master data through ChatGPT. It supports guided discovery, scoped list and detail lookups, financial reporting, DMS metadata and content search, document retrieval, order inspection, payroll snapshots, and master-data access. Large read results can be retrieved through authenticated attachments. With a separately approved OAuth permission, it can create uncommitted accounting sequences; it cannot finalize them. LODAS requires the exchange service to be enabled for the selected client. DMS content search is available only for eligible accounts. Access is limited to the DATEV data and operations permitted for the authenticated user.
payload.longDescription: Klardaten DATEV-Connector 让获授权用户通过 ChatGPT 受控访问 DATEV 会计、工资（Lohn und Gehalt 和 LODAS）、文档管理、订单管理及主数据。它支持引导式发现、限定范围的列表与详情查询、财务报告、DMS 元数据和内容搜索、文档获取、订单查看、工资快照及主数据访问。较大的读取结果可通过经过身份验证的附件获取。获得单独批准的 OAuth 权限后，它可以创建尚未提交的会计序列，但不能最终确认这些序列。LODAS 要求为选定客户启用交换服务。DMS 内容搜索仅适用于符合条件的账户。访问范围仅限已认证用户获准使用的 DATEV 数据和操作。

payload.name: GoCardless
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your GoCardless account to look up payments, customers, mandates, payouts, and refunds, and to take actions such as creating payments, issuing refunds and cancelling mandates.

You choose what permissions to authorise when you connect. Money-moving actions show a preview and wait for your confirmation. Sensitive data such as customer email addresses are partly hidden before the model sees them. Bank account details are never shared.

Building on the GoCardless API? Ask for integration guidance and code samples, and connect to Sandbox to test.
payload.longDescription:
连接 GoCardless 账户，查询付款、客户、扣款授权、结算款和退款，并执行创建付款、发起退款及取消扣款授权等操作。

连接时由你选择授权哪些权限。涉及资金转移的操作会展示预览，并等待你的确认。客户邮箱等敏感数据在模型看到之前会被部分隐藏。银行账户详情绝不共享。

正在使用 GoCardless API 开发？可以索取集成指导和代码示例，并连接 Sandbox 进行测试。

payload.name: Octus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Octus' verified credit intelligence directly in Claude and other LLMs. The Octus MCP Connector™ delivers proprietary intel, issuer fundamentals, private data room documents and covenant analysis across 95%+ of the sub-investment grade credit universe. Query permissioned content in real time using natural language, power autonomous agent workflows and ground your AI systems in a trusted, standardized data source. Built for investment managers, banks, law firms and advisors who need research-grade answers at the speed of the market.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 Claude 及其他大语言模型中访问 Octus 已核实的信贷情报。Octus MCP Connector™ 提供专有情报、发行人基本面、私有数据室文档及契约条款分析，覆盖 95%+ 的非投资级信贷市场。使用自然语言实时查询具有访问权限的内容，支持自主智能体工作流，并让 AI 系统以可信、标准化的数据源为基础。专为需要以市场速度获取研究级答案的投资管理人、银行、律师事务所及顾问打造。

payload.name: Harmonic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, enrich, and research startups, companies and investors using Harmonic's proprietary data on millions of companies and the people behind them. Get detailed company profiles with funding, location, founders, and network connections. Use natural language to find companies matching specific criteria. Create and manage lists of companies and people. Access your team's network mapping and saved searches. Discover startups earlier, research them faster, and act with confidence—an AI-powered research agent built into your workflow.
payload.longDescription: 利用 Harmonic 关于数百万家企业及其背后人员的专有数据，搜索、补充和研究初创公司、企业及投资者。获取包含融资、所在地、创始人及人脉关系的详细企业资料。使用自然语言查找符合特定条件的企业。创建和管理企业与人员列表。访问团队的人脉关系图及已保存的搜索。更早发现初创公司、更快开展研究并有把握地行动——这是融入您工作流程的 AI 研究智能体。

payload.name: Boleron AI Insurance Broker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare real-time insurance prices from top carriers in Bulgaria. Instantly calculate vehicle motor third-party liability (MTPL / Гражданска отговорност) and travel insurance rates tailored to your specific needs.

The app generates instant price comparisons, detailed coverage limits, policy exclusions, and key product features across multiple insurers to help you evaluate options before you buy.

Ideal for checking car liability pricing or planning travel coverage inside the chat. To get a final legally binding offer and complete your transaction, you can seamlessly transfer your vehicle or trip parameters to boleron.bg
payload.longDescription:
比较保加利亚领先保险公司的实时保险价格。根据具体需求，即时计算机动车第三者责任险（MTPL / Гражданска отговорност）和旅行保险费率。

应用即时生成多家保险公司的价格对照、详细保障限额、免责条款和主要产品特点，帮助你在购买前评估选择。

适合在聊天中查看汽车责任险价格或规划旅行保障。要获取最终具有法律约束力的报价并完成交易，可顺畅地将车辆或行程参数传至 boleron.bg。

payload.name: Any Exchange Rate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Toggle between exchange rates and convert different amounts without having to leave ChatGPT.

e.g. Just ask ChatGPT: "@Any Exchange Rate How much is 300 dollars in euros?"

Once the app is open, switch amounts or currencies, then carry on chatting- the model will be updated with the final figures.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可切换汇率并换算不同金额。

例如，只需问 ChatGPT：“@Any Exchange Rate 300 美元等于多少欧元？”

打开应用后，切换金额或币种，然后继续聊天，模型会收到最终数值更新。

payload.name: Chronograph LP
payload.description: 值得信赖的投资组合数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chronograph LP provides portfolio monitoring and analytics solutions for private capital investors. Through the Chronograph LP App within ChatGPT and Codex, users can access the full depth of their trusted private markets portfolio data using natural language, from underlying portfolio companies and assets to funds, vehicles, commitments, and more.

Chronograph provides two separate Apps for different client user types: Chronograph LP for Limited Partner users and Chronograph GP for General Partner users.
payload.longDescription:
Chronograph LP 为私募资本投资者提供投资组合监测和分析解决方案。通过 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中的 Chronograph LP 应用，用户可使用自然语言全面访问可信赖的私募市场投资组合数据，从底层被投公司和资产，到基金、投资载体、认缴承诺等。

Chronograph 为不同类型的客户用户提供两个独立应用：面向有限合伙人用户的 Chronograph LP，以及面向普通合伙人用户的 Chronograph GP。

payload.name: Bankrate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This tool specializes in providing current consumer banking rates and calculating savings projections. It is designed to be an objective, non-advisory resource.
payload.longDescription: 此工具专门提供当前面向消费者的银行利率，并计算储蓄预测。它旨在成为客观且不提供咨询建议的信息资源。

payload.name: Zocks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zocks connects to the client data financial advisors rely on - including conversation intelligence, meeting insights, and the goals, concerns, and planning opportunities captured across every interaction. With access to this context through Zocks, you can analyze client history to surface tax considerations, estate planning signals, and other client-specific insights advisors may want to explore further.
payload.longDescription: Zocks 连接财务顾问所依赖的客户数据，包括对话情报、会议洞见，以及在每次互动中捕捉的目标、顾虑和规划机会。通过 Zocks 访问这些上下文后，你可以分析客户历史，发现税务考量、遗产规划信号，以及顾问可能希望进一步探索的其他客户专属洞见。

payload.name: Freeway Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get an estimated auto insurance rate through a simple conversation. Answer a few questions about yourself, your drivers, and your vehicles, then continue with Freeway for a more detailed quote.
payload.longDescription: 通过简单对话获得汽车保险费率估算。回答几个关于你本人、驾驶人和车辆的问题，再前往 Freeway 获取更详细的报价。

payload.name: Mashvisor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mashvisor helps users search investment properties, inspect listing details and photos, and compare Traditional vs Airbnb cash-flow projections using Mashvisor market data.
payload.longDescription: Mashvisor 帮助用户搜索投资房产、查看房源详情和照片，并利用 Mashvisor 市场数据，比较传统出租与 Airbnb 出租的现金流预测。

payload.name: Kredit
payload.description: 寻找最适合的阿联酋信用卡
payload.summaryOriginal: Find the UAE best credit cards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kredit is a UAE-focused credit card comparison website that helps you quickly find cards that match how you actually spend. In one place, you can browse offers from multiple banks and compare key details side by side — like cashback rates, rewards, welcome bonuses, annual fees, eligibility requirements, and core benefits (travel perks, lounge access, dining discounts, and more).

Instead of digging through scattered pages, Kredit makes it easier to narrow your options with simple filters and clear explanations of what each feature means in practice. Whether you’re looking for everyday savings on groceries and fuel, better value on flights and hotels, or a low-fee card to keep things simple, you can sort and compare cards based on what matters most to you.
payload.longDescription:
Kredit 是面向阿联酋的信用卡比较网站，帮助你快速找到符合实际消费方式的卡片。在一个地方浏览多家银行的优惠，并并排比较返现比例、奖励、开卡礼、年费、资格要求及核心权益（旅行福利、贵宾室使用权、餐饮折扣等）等关键详情。

无需翻查零散网页，Kredit 通过简单筛选和清晰解释各项功能的实际意义，让你更容易缩小选择范围。无论希望日常购买食品和燃油更省钱、机票酒店更划算，还是选择低费用信用卡以保持简单，都可依据最重视的因素对卡片排序和比较。

payload.name: Mortgage IQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Calculate your exact monthly mortgage payments instantly with live data. This interactive calculator goes beyond the basics to pull real-time interest rates directly from the Federal Reserve, ensuring your estimates are always perfectly accurate to the market.

Visualize your home-buying budget with detailed, easy-to-read charts that break down your exact costs—principals versus interest—over the entire lifespan of your term. Plan your financial future clearly, test different purchase prices, and generate customized amortization schedules in seconds.
payload.longDescription:
利用实时数据，立即计算准确的每月房贷还款。此交互式计算器不止提供基本功能，还直接从美联储获取实时利率，确保估算始终与市场完全准确地匹配。

通过详细、易读的图表直观查看购房预算，将整个贷款期限的准确成本拆分为本金和利息。清晰规划财务未来，测试不同购买价格，并在数秒内生成定制的摊还计划。

payload.name: LunarCrush
payload.description: 为搜索添加实时社交数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Add real-time social media data to your searches with LunarCrush. LunarCrush measures what the world is paying attention to by analyzing millions of public social posts every hour to reveal the sentiment, engagement, and momentum behind any stock, topic, or creator. Ask what people are saying about an asset, how the conversation is trending over time, and who is driving it. Whether you are researching a brand, tracking a ticker, or following a market narrative or specific creator, LunarCrush brings real time social context directly into ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 通过 LunarCrush 为搜索加入实时社交媒体数据。LunarCrush 每小时分析数百万条公开社交帖子，衡量全球关注焦点，揭示任何股票、话题或创作者背后的情绪、互动和动势。可以询问人们如何谈论某项资产、讨论随时间如何变化，以及谁在推动讨论。无论研究品牌、跟踪证券代码，还是关注市场叙事或特定创作者，LunarCrush 都将实时社交背景直接带入 ChatGPT。

payload.name: WikiFx
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WikiFX is a third-party financial information platform specializing in the global foreign exchange (Forex) industry. It aggregates and verifies official data from over 60 regulatory authorities worldwide. The platform features a scoring system that evaluates brokers across five key dimensions: Regulation, License, Risk Control, Software, and Business. The final results will be presented in the form of a score.
payload.longDescription: WikiFX 是专注于全球外汇（Forex）行业的第三方金融信息平台。它汇总并核实全球超过 60 家监管机构的官方数据。平台拥有评分系统，从监管、牌照、风险控制、软件和业务 5 个关键维度评估经纪商。最终结果以评分形式呈现。

payload.name: MetricDuck
payload.description: 审计级 SEC 申报数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Answers about U.S. public companies grounded in primary SEC filings, with every figure linked back to its source on SEC EDGAR. Pull exact as-filed XBRL facts and multi-period financial statements, track a metric across fiscal periods, screen and rank 5,500+ companies by financials, compare peers, read filing sections (risk factors, MD&A, earnings), and full-text search SEC EDGAR. Coverage: 10-K/10-Q (and amendments), 8-K, 20-F/40-F/6-K (foreign issuers that file with the SEC), and DEF 14A proxy statements. Not covered: insider/ownership filings (Forms 3/4/5, 13D/G), institutional holdings (13F), or registration/offering prospectuses (S-1, 424B). Updated daily from SEC EDGAR; daily end-of-day prices from a market-data feed. Informational research tool, not investment advice. Free up to 500 queries/day.
payload.longDescription: 基于 SEC 原始申报文件回答美国上市公司问题，每个数字都链接回 SEC EDGAR 上的来源。提取与申报原文一致的准确 XBRL 事实和多期财务报表，跨财政期间追踪指标，按财务数据筛选并排名 5,500+ 家公司，比较同业，阅读申报章节（风险因素、MD&A、财报），并对 SEC EDGAR 进行全文搜索。覆盖范围：10-K/10-Q（及修订文件）、8-K、20-F/40-F/6-K（向 SEC 申报的外国发行人），以及 DEF 14A 委托投票声明。不覆盖：内部人士/所有权申报（Forms 3/4/5、13D/G）、机构持仓（13F）或注册/发行招股说明书（S-1、424B）。每天从 SEC EDGAR 更新；市场数据源提供每日收盘价格。这是信息研究工具，不提供投资建议。每日最多 500 次查询免费。

payload.name: SecureLend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SecureLend helps users compare loan and financing options across multiple categories in one place.

Users can review and compare business loans, personal loans, mortgages, auto financing, student loans, and other financing scenarios. SecureLend provides calculators and comparison tools to help users understand estimated rates, payments, and trade-offs. SecureLend does not collect sensitive personal information and only gathers limited prequalification details when necessary. SecureLend is designed to operate without authentication, and all features are accessible without sign-in.

SecureLend does not provide loans or make credit decisions. All results are informational only. When users choose to apply, they are guided to third-party providers and explicitly consent before any information is shared.

SecureLend is designed as a modular financial comparison platform and may expand to additional financial products over time.
payload.longDescription:
SecureLend 帮助用户在一个地方比较多个类别的贷款和融资方案。

用户可以查看和比较商业贷款、个人贷款、住房按揭、汽车融资、学生贷款及其他融资场景。SecureLend 提供计算器和比较工具，帮助用户理解预估利率、付款额和取舍。SecureLend 不收集敏感个人信息，仅在必要时收集有限的预资格审核信息。SecureLend 无需身份验证即可运行，所有功能都无需登录即可访问。

SecureLend 不发放贷款，也不作出信贷决定。所有结果仅供参考。用户选择申请时，会被引导至第三方提供商，任何信息共享前均需获得用户明确同意。

SecureLend 采用模块化金融比较平台设计，未来可能扩展至更多金融产品。

payload.name: Found
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Found business account to ask questions about your finances in plain language. Check balances, find and export transactions, review your categorized books and profit and loss, spot missing receipts, and see which invoices are unpaid or overdue. The connection is read-only: it can't move money, pay bills, or change your books. You sign in with your Found account and can disconnect at any time.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Found 企业账户，用日常语言询问财务问题。查看余额、查找和导出交易、回顾已分类的账簿及损益、发现缺失收据，并查看哪些发票未付款或已逾期。连接为只读，不能转移资金、支付账单或修改账簿。使用 Found 账户登录，可随时断开连接。

payload.name: Paribu
payload.description: Paribu 实时加密货币价格
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Paribu brings live crypto market data into ChatGPT. Ask for the current price and 24-hour statistics (change, high, low, volume) of any coin listed on Paribu, in Turkish lira (TL) or USDT. You can also browse markets ranked by trading volume, top gainers and top losers — including sports fan tokens.
payload.longDescription: Paribu 将实时加密货币市场数据带入 ChatGPT。询问 Paribu 上任意上市币种的当前价格及 24 小时统计数据（涨跌幅、最高价、最低价、成交量），以土耳其里拉（TL）或 USDT 计价。还可浏览按交易量排序的市场、涨幅榜及跌幅榜，包括体育球迷代币。

payload.name: Chargebee (US Region)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

payload.longDescription:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和支付数据。用自然语言询问账单问题，即时获得答案：续订风险、支付失败模式、贷项通知单缺口、按账单周期划分的客户终身价值（LTV）及试用转化。

payload.name: Allianz Direct España
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

How it works:

Simply describe your car's characteristics and what you need (e.g., "A basic third-party car insurance for a Seat Ibiza"). The app will generate a corresponding non-binding policy outline. You can then ask the assistant for information about the coverage, request modifications to the details, or ask for explanations of specific clauses to see how the coverage adapts to your needs and what options are available. If you wish to proceed, the app will request the necessary details and provide a price estimate. For an official quote or policy issuance, users are directed to Allianz Direct's official purchasing channels.

Note: This tool is for informational and exploration purposes only, providing estimates based on the details shared in the chat. Official policy issuance requires verification through Allianz Direct Spain's official website. The insurance part of the Service that Allianz Direct operates is subject to human oversight by Allianz; you may contact human advisors at any time through Allianz Direct's official channels. 

Please bear in mind that AI systems may produce outputs that are inaccurate, incomplete or not fully adapted to specific circumstances, and the accuracy of any indicative quotation depends directly on the accuracy and completeness of the information provided.

Important: Do NOT provide payment data (bank account numbers, IBANs, payment card details), national identity documents (DNI/NIE), passport numbers or any other sensitive personal identification data through this chat. Such data should only be provided through Allianz Direct's secure contracting environment. 

Data required for quotation: To generate an indicative quotation, the Service will request the following information: date of birth, driving license details, vehicle data (registration plate, date of first registration and type of use), postcode, estimated annual mileage and payment frequency preference. The Service does not collect national identification documents or any special categories of personal data.
payload.longDescription:
Allianz Direct Spain 汽车保险探索工具让你在 ChatGPT 中以透明的方式查看并理解 Allianz Direct 的汽车保险选项。它帮助你了解汽车保险保单可以如何配置，注重清晰说明和个性化选择。使用此应用，你可以设计可能的保单配置、了解保障详情，并在无需承诺购买的情况下获取预估价格。

主要功能：
• 详细保障分析：针对特定车型，详细说明 Allianz Direct 保单已包含及可以纳入的保障内容。

• 术语解释：即时查询保险概念（例如“附加保障”或“除外责任”）的定义，确保充分理解所用术语。

• 交互式定制：了解责任限额或具体保障项目等保单参数，查看它们如何影响保险预估价格。

使用方式：

只需描述车辆特点和你的需求（例如“为 Seat Ibiza 配置一份基本的第三者责任汽车保险”）。应用会生成相应的、不具约束力的保单方案。随后，你可以向助手询问保障信息、要求修改细节，或请求解释具体条款，了解保障如何适应你的需求，以及有哪些可选方案。如果你希望继续，应用将询问必要信息并提供价格估算。如需正式报价或签发保单，用户将被引导至 Allianz Direct 的官方购买渠道。

注意：此工具仅用于获取信息和探索方案，根据聊天中提供的详情给出估算。正式签发保单需要通过 Allianz Direct Spain 官方网站核验。Allianz Direct 所运营服务中的保险部分受 Allianz 的人工监督；你可以随时通过 Allianz Direct 官方渠道联系人工顾问。

请注意，AI 系统可能生成不准确、不完整或未充分适应具体情况的内容，任何参考报价的准确性直接取决于所提供信息的准确性和完整性。

重要：请勿通过此聊天提供支付资料（银行账号、IBAN、支付卡详情）、国民身份证件（DNI/NIE）、护照号码或任何其他敏感个人身份识别资料。这些资料只能通过 Allianz Direct 的安全签约环境提供。

报价所需资料：为生成参考报价，服务将询问以下信息：出生日期、驾驶证详情、车辆资料（车牌号、首次登记日期和用途）、邮政编码、预计年行驶里程以及付款频率偏好。服务不会收集国民身份证件或任何特殊类别的个人资料。

payload.name: UK Property Valuation
payload.description: 英国独栋住宅和公寓估值
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wondering what a UK home is worth? This app helps you explore that inside ChatGPT using real sold prices and energy-performance certificates — not guesswork from listing sites.

Give it an address or postcode and you get a clear property report: recent sales nearby, certificate ratings and floor area where available, a map of the area, and how local prices compare on a per-square-foot basis. You can also search certificates by postcode — useful if you care about energy ratings (for example homes rated E to G when planning retrofit work).

The data is official UK open information: Land Registry transaction prices and the public EPC register, for England and Wales. The app is for research only. It does not list homes for sale, take payments, book viewings, file EPC paperwork, or replace a formal surveyor's valuation or mortgage decision. For major financial choices, use the report as a starting point and speak to a qualified professional where you need one.
payload.longDescription:
想知道英国住宅值多少钱？这款应用帮助你在ChatGPT内使用真实成交价格和能源性能证书进行研究，而非依靠房源网站的猜测。

提供地址或邮编，即可获得清晰的房产报告：附近近期成交、可获取的证书评级和建筑面积、区域地图，以及按每平方英尺计算的本地房价比较。你也可以按邮编搜索证书，如果关注能源评级，这会很实用，例如在规划节能改造时查找评级为E至G的住宅。

数据来自英国官方公开信息：涵盖英格兰和威尔士的Land Registry成交价格及公共EPC登记册。该应用仅用于研究。它不发布待售房源、不收取付款、不预约看房、不提交EPC文件，也不能代替测量师的正式估值或贷款决策。对于重大财务选择，请将报告作为起点，并在需要时咨询具备资质的专业人士。
